title: LLM4Verilog: Building Large-Scale, High-Quality Data Infrastructure for Verilog Code Generation via Community Efforts
problem: High-quality training datasets for Verilog code generation are limited. Existing datasets lack scale and diversity for robust LLM fine-tuning.
motivation: Large-scale, high-quality Verilog datasets enable LLM-based hardware design automation, reducing design cycle time and improving design quality.
method: Community-driven dataset collection and curation infrastructure for Verilog code generation. LLM fine-tuning on the dataset with pass@1 evaluation. Achieves 6.6-13.2% improvements in pass@1 metrics via fine-tuning.
key_novelty: Large-scale community-driven Verilog dataset infrastructure for LLM training with demonstrated pass@1 improvements.
limitations: Dataset composition, generalization to unseen RTL patterns, and comparison with other code generation approaches not detailed.
